key_concepts: Animals are living things found in surroundings.
Some animals live on land, some in water, and some on both land and water.
Common pets include dogs, cats, turtles, parrots, doves, and fish.
Farm animals include chickens, ducks, goats, pigs, carabaos, cows, and horses.
Animals have different body coverings such as shell, feathers, fur, scales, and skin.
Animals may have two legs or four legs.
Animals move by walking, crawling, flying, hopping, running, or swimming.
Animals use body parts such as legs and wings to move.
A carabao is a farm helper that plows fields.
A dog is a loyal house guard.
A cat has fur, a long tail, sharp claws, and hunts rats.
A frog can live both on land and in water.
